CustomField.description: Used to be picked up to get placed in the Roll 3 months data back to an Account
CustomField.formula:
AND( DATE( VALUE(RIGHT(Year_Month__c, 4)), VALUE(LEFT(Year_Month__c, FIND("/", Year_Month__c) - 1)), 1 ) >= ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), -2),
DATE( VALUE(RIGHT(Year_Month__c, 4)), VALUE(LEFT(Year_Month__c, FIND("/", Year_Month__c) - 1)), 1 ) < ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) )
CustomField.label: Rolling 3 Month
